radiusSource: Radius 5.53 (+1.77/-0.79) solar radii and mass 13.60 (+2.2/-1.8) solar masses from Habibi et al. (2017, ApJ 847, 120; arXiv:1708.06353), Table 3, model-atmosphere fit to SINFONI spectra (Teff 28513 K, B0-B3), at 695,700 km per solar radius and the JPL solar GM.
orbitalPeriodSource: Derived: Kepler's third law with a = 0.12495 arcsec x 8277 pc = 1034.21 au and the central mass 4.297e6 solar masses (GRAVITY 2022, Table 1): sqrt(1034.21^3 / 4.297e6) = 16.0447 yr of 365.25 d. The table prints no period.

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius in the shared neutral gray. No image, colour, map or oblateness of S2 is measured; only its size, mass and orbit are.

effectiveTemperatureSource: Habibi et al. (2017), ApJ 847, 120, Table 3: Teff 28,513 (+2,388/-2,923) K (https://arxiv.org/abs/1708.06353)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/s2.json, log10(GM/R^2) in cgs, rounded to two decimals
massSource: 13.6 solar masses: Habibi et al. (2017), ApJ 847, 120, Table 3: 13.60 (+2.2/-1.8) solar masses (https://arxiv.org/abs/1708.06353).
